---
name: Data or API issue
about: Chart shows wrong data, missing data, or the CAISO API is failing
labels: data
---

**Which chart or endpoint is affected?**
e.g. LMP chart, /api/stats, fuel mix

**What does the data look like vs. what you expected?**
Describe the discrepancy.

**Approximate time window**
When did you notice it? What time range were you viewing?

**Is this reproducible?**
- [ ] Yes, consistently
- [ ] Intermittent
- [ ] Only once

**Error shown in the browser console or server logs?**
Paste any relevant output here.

**Additional context**
CAISO sometimes delays or revises data. Check the [CAISO OASIS status page](http://oasis.caiso.com) before filing if you suspect an upstream issue.
